description: This file defines the NetworkActiveNotifier class, which manages network activity notifications in Chrome on Android, interfacing with native code and the Android ConnectivityManager.

classes.name: NetworkActiveNotifier
classes.description: Manages network activity notifications, interfaces with native code, and handles Android connectivity events.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Creates a NetworkActiveNotifier instance from native code.

methods.name: isDefaultNetworkActive
methods.description: Checks if the default network is active.

methods.name: onNetworkActive
methods.description: Callback invoked when network becomes active; notifies native code.

methods.name: fakeDefaultNetworkActive
methods.description: Simulates a network active event for testing purposes.
